difficulty_reason: The lemma proves an Euler characteristic formula relating the kernel and cokernel dimensions of the two comparison maps obtained from a commutative square of fields, and the proof is a 27-line argument that compares two Jacobi-Zariski exact sequences. It writes the six term sequence for each of the two towers of field extensions, embeds each of the two comparison maps into the corresponding sequence, and then evaluates the resulting alternating sums using a finiteness statement about the relevant vector spaces proved in the same chapter. The comparison of the two sequences is the substance, and both displays are given in full.
